comments.value:
Maybe as a suggestion before this is patched, instead of an "Ok" button for the "Instance is full" message, substitute it with three other buttons to replace it.
"Try again." to attempt going back in.
"Go to fallback instance."
"Return to Home."
@{600bb08cb76d6f78b108fb38|full_name}: I like this idea. Should make a feature request for this too since it will get more visibility that way!

If you don't have the "skip go button in load", after you return to home, everytime you try to rejoin, you get a "you cannot access this world" for the rest of your play session, requiring you to restart VRC.

@{600bb08cb76d6f78b108fb38|full_name}: Hell, I'd say just give us our main menu. Then I can go straight to joining somewhere else instead of waiting around to load another instance, then joining somewhere else.
@{5ae14b192f26cf1a6d66ba79|full_name}: Seems like the new Go Home button has a "default" option to take you to the VRChat Home, so this option might be doable.
@{600bb08cb76d6f78b108fb38|full_name}: "Trying Again" could be really useful for raves. Better than spamming friends with invite requests.
magic wand someday would be some kind of queue system where folks dont have to keep mashing to get into a full instance
Yeah this loading loop is a bit of a pain. Thanks for raising this report!

@{62def87167455d44a141e91e|full_name}: Per my comment from below:
Maybe as a suggestion before this is patched, instead of an "Ok" button for the "Instance is full" message, substitute it with three other buttons to replace it.
"Try again." to attempt going back in.
"Go to fallback instance."
"Return to Home."
This is currently partially fixed on live release and fully fixed on Open Beta

@{5b12d42e9ad122540bc69858|full_name}: Thanks! Put in a canny suggestion regarding below comments. :)
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/give-more-options-on-instance-is-full-prompt

details:
After attempting to load myself into an instance that was full, VRChat continued to load me into the instance, versus placing me in a fallback instance. 
Initially found on SteamVR client, is reproduceable, and also happens on Native Quest client.
I could not click "Return to Home" since the loading screen initialized too fast, placing me in a softlock.
title: [1213] Full instances don't place you in a fallback instance
